visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A group of King Penguins waddles across a snowy path, their distinctive yellow neck patches contrasting with their black and white bodies. Tourists stand behind a rope boundary in the background, mostly wearing thick winter coats. (2) A woman with a cheerful expression and a man wearing sunglasses and a fluffy penguin hat take a selfie, smiling broadly into the camera while the penguins walk past in the distance. (3) The scene shifts to the main entrance of Asahiyama Zoo, featuring a modern building with wooden vertical slats and a white logo on a dark background; a large crowd of visitors is gathered outside. (4) A woman in a grey puffer jacket and white beanie holds up a smartphone, displaying a QR code ticket on the screen in front of a ticket window. (5) A long queue of visitors stretches across the snowy zoo grounds, with bare trees and white buildings under an overcast, grey winter sky. (6) Several penguins are shown in a close-up shot, one penguin is seen sliding on its belly across the snow with its flippers extended, while others walk upright in a line. (7) A white goat stands atop a narrow wooden beam structure covered in snow, looking towards the camera against a backdrop of snow-laden evergreen trees and wooden zoo buildings. (8) Three white ducks rest or huddle together on a patch of trampled snow near a wooden fence. (9) A polar bear is visible inside an enclosure, partially obscured by a wire mesh fence, moving near a red plastic toy. (10) A large tiger with orange and black stripes paces behind a chain-link fence, its breath occasionally visible in the cold air. (11) The exterior of the 'Zoo club Gallery' is shown, a wooden building with signs featuring polar bear illustrations; a woman points toward the entrance. (12) Inside a gift shop, rows of plush toys including grey seals and brown red pandas are displayed on glass shelves. (13) The main couple and three other friends pose for a group photo in front of a large snow-covered zoo monument; everyone is smiling and dressed in heavy winter gear. (14) The woman and man, both in penguin hats, perform a playful waddle dance in the deep snow towards the camera, laughing as they move through a forest-like setting.

(6) [Subtitle]: 可愛的企鵝遊行. (7) [Subtitle]: 建議可以先在網路購票. (8) [Subtitle]: 現場是連入場都要排隊哦. (9) [Subtitle]: 第一場 11:00 第二場 14:30 企鵝遊行一天有兩場. (10) [Subtitle]: 很多人一入園就直衝遊行方向. (11) [Subtitle]: 跟著人潮走就對了. (12) [Subtitle]: 企鵝散步主要是解決冬天運動. (13) [Subtitle]: 增加他們的體力. (14) [Subtitle]: 幫忙之後去繁殖養精蓄銳. (15) [Subtitle]: 搖搖晃晃的企鵝實在太萌了. (16) [Subtitle]: 這麽近的距離看真的很不真實. (17) [Subtitle]: 還抓包到一隻偷懶企鵝. (18) [Subtitle]: 直接在地上滑起冰來. (19) [Subtitle]: 另外日本動物園好處就是. (20) [Subtitle]: 跟動物的距離都很近. (21) [Subtitle]: 有比較溫馴的可受動物區. (22) [Subtitle]: 也有很帥的猛禽類們. (23) [Subtitle]: 園區一些插畫跟裝置小巧思. (24) [Subtitle]: 我覺得也很好拍照. (25) [Logo]: ASAHIYAMA Zoo club Gallery. [Subtitle]: 最後別忘記到商店街逛逛. (26) [Logo]: TAX FREE. [Subtitle]: 有很多可愛的玩偶跟動物園限定單品. (27) [Subtitle]: 還可以在門口拍張紀念照. (28) [Subtitle]: 趕快分享給喜歡動物的朋友吧!.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a cheerful, mid-tempo acoustic guitar melody accompanied by a soft drum beat. A female voice speaks with a high, enthusiastic pitch, introducing the penguin parade in Hokkaido. (2) The background music continues steadily as the female narrator explains the location of the zoo. Subtle ambient crowd chatter and laughter can be heard beneath the primary vocal track. (3) The narrator provides advice on booking tickets online, her tone remaining friendly and professional. The music maintains its bright, major-mode harmony throughout this phase. (4) As the narration describes the schedule and health benefits for the penguins, the vocal delivery remains clear and rhythmic. The BGM remains consistent in volume and tempo. (5) The female voice expresses excitement while describing the penguins' 'moe' (cute) appearance. The acoustic BGM swells slightly in the mix during a brief pause in speech. (6) The narrator continues to detail other zoo attractions, including the close proximity to animals. The sound of light footsteps in the snow is faintly audible in the background mix. (7) Final call to action is delivered with high energy as the female narrator encourages viewers to share the video. The music concludes with a final resolved chord on the guitar.
